author: Odango, Emerson Lopez
title: Afféú fangani 'join together': A morphophonemic analysis of possessive suffix paradigms and a discourse-based ethnography of the elicitation session in Pakin Lukunosh Mortlockese
notes: PhD dissertation, University of Hawai'i at Mānoa, May 2015 (committee Kenneth L. Rehg, chair). Details from the title page. Consulted directly on 25 November 2026. The language described is 'the Pakin geolect of the Lukunosh dialect of Mortlockese' (abstract), spoken on Pakin Atoll, Pohnpei State.
